phases.title: Engineering Intake & Evidence Harness Readiness
deliverables: Select source repository and accountable maintainers
Choose supported runtime/dev/test environments
Define CI/test harness, secure artifact store, run provenance, P0 safety plan
Create independent signed-R read-only authenticity/semantic validator as P2 follow-up
Review source candidates from MyDmsVn, SaasOne, FullStackHero and a new dedicated repository; Owner to approve S6-0-REPO-01
entryConditions: PR2 merge ba6d526 verified for prerequisite; S6-0 still awaits repository/owners/env selection
exitCriteria: Approved source repository ownership and commit controls
Engineer/QA/Ops approved test environments with seeded synthetic data and no uncontrolled production effects
Evidence provenance and P0 run safety plan documented

phases.title: Foundation: Authority, Transaction, Ledgers & Online G-IDEMP
deliverables: Tenant authority and revocation boundaries
SQL atomic stock/AR/custody/advance/CustomerCredit with source-line before-after
Durable inbox/outbox, canonical command/effect IDs, replay, lost ACK, concurrent grants
Online scoped EV-08 durable ACK/idempotency evidence without offline device admission
exitCriteria: Online idempotency invariant checked against actual API/SQL build

phases.title: Module A Online E2E: Partial Delivery, Pricing, Returns & Cost
deliverables: A order draft/confirm with commercial price locked and installment terms snapshot
Partial delivery by source, hold/quota separation, no premature AR
Return to quarantine separate from gift settlement and legal adjustment
Moving-average SKU × location and Finance periodic bridge
Invoice/accounting integration contract and actual test evidence per scope
entryConditions: Seller/provider legal test scope identified before external integration
exitCriteria: A online source-line accounting/stock/cost diffs independently reviewed

phases.title: B_ONLINE + MIXED: Atomic B, Invoice Channel & Accounting
deliverables: Verified invoice channel gate for B_ONLINE and fail-closed provider UNKNOWN recovery
BQuota/credit/receipt atomicity and independent A hold
Independent MIXED A+B_ONLINE E2E
Accounting API/FILE/MANUAL_REGISTER POSTED/read-back/reconciliation
No alternative invoice channel on PWA disconnect; B_NO_CHANNEL remains blocked
entryConditions: Real provider/seller/accounting sandbox and legal review available
exitCriteria: Independent B_ONLINE/MIXED evidence with source/external refs
B_NO_CHANNEL and B alternative offline channel are not enabled

phases.title: Conditional Offline A: Device/Trip Grant, Replay, Revoke, Restore
deliverables: PWA IndexedDB durable journal, TTL/epoch/mode/device/trip scope, one writer per trip
Lost ACK/replay/concurrency/device loss/restore negative cases
External authority and PrivacyActionLedger outside rollback
F-01..22 controlled fault plan and evidence where applicable
entryConditions: Authorized device matrix and controlled fault-injection sandbox
exitCriteria: EV-08/09 verified separately for OFFLINE_WRITE in real-device scope
Offline grant remains disabled until distinct admission

phases.title: Full Kho-01 Cutover, Legacy Writer Fencing & Forward Recovery
deliverables: C0..C8 opening manifest across MAIN/TRIP/lot/hold/quota/AR/custody/advance/invoices
Inventory and block legacy UI/API/job/import/direct SQL/device queues across ENTIRE Kho-01 including off-wave
Multi-party approved opening, generation/firstEffectId fencing
Rehearsed forward-only recovery and DR external registry reconciliation
Inventory and fence legacy offline devices, stale grants and pending queues, even when OFFLINE_WRITE remains disabled
entryConditions: P0 safeguards independent of pilot trip count
TADR-04 authority/revocation/restore scope must be reviewed for cutover, independent of completing optional Offline A feature
exitCriteria: EV-04/12 and per-mode cutover evidence reviewed; P0 failures stay NO_GO
Do not rollback business effects after firstEffectId
Online-only A/B_ONLINE/MIXED cutover shall not require full S6-D optional Offline A E2E, while EV-09 restore/revocation evidence still applies

phases.title: Pilot Readiness and NPP-01 Representative Pilot Go/No-Go
deliverables: Review UX-01..08 and denominator n/N with device/role coverage
Measure/propose SLO, support costs, RPO/RTO, retention and approve thresholds BEFORE EV-14
Pilot EV-14 readiness signed before any actual pilot start
Pilot EV-15 after ≥5 representative days with 3 A + 3 B_ONLINE + 2 MIXED per day for NPP-01 only
Per-mode Product Verification and separate tenant Go/No-Go with approved evidence
entryConditions: Mode-specific P0/real evidence and tenant cutover gates passed before EV-14
NPP-01 authorized actual pilot plan, staff and equipment
exitCriteria: EV-14 evidence before Pilot; EV-15 only after actual pilot
No automatic mode admission or unverified Go-Live

backlogControls.title: Post-signoff read-only validator for acceptance record R
backlogControls.rule: Must cross-check actual GitHub comment login, time, SHA, reviewer refs, findings, and exact-sha CI; signed JSON alone is not proof.
